integrity: The explicit ordered 3428-step relative-collapse certificate and independent exhaustive reconstruction checker accompany the statement. Earlier homotopy and face-vector results are credited; no independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the tetrahedral three-simplex and its boundary; it is a simplicial collapse of the pure acyclic complexes, not of the ordinary or generalized matching complexes, and no equivariant collapse sequence is claimed.
title: A relative simplicial collapse between the pure Morse complexes of a tetrahedron and its boundary
